claim.claim-text: 2. The sound attenuator of claim 1, wherein the hollow cavity is a Helmholz resonator tuned to 2 kHz.
3. The sound attenuator of claim 1, wherein the push button actuator outer button surface is generally triangular with curved sides and rounded points.
4. The sound attenuator of claim 3, further comprising one or more seal inserts having an outline shape which matches the outline shape of the push button actuator.

5. The sound attenuator of claim 1, wherein the one or more openings in the sidewall have a total opening area, and open sound tube end has a sound tube end cross-sectional area, and wherein the total opening area is equal to or greater than the sound tube end cross-sectional area.
6. The sound attenuator of claim 1, wherein the one or more openings in the sidewall are located on a portion of the sidewall which faces forward.

8. The sound attenuator of claim 7, wherein the body is generally triangular with curved walls and rounded points and the push button actuator has an outline shape which is generally triangular with curved sides and rounded points.
